We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About The Role The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission. We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator in our Tokyo office to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process in Japan and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion. What You’ll Do Create a candidate experience that reflects Notion You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll balance speed with attention to detail, anticipate needs, and communicate proactively to keep candidates and interviewers aligned. You’ll ensure logistics, materials, and feedback loops are clear and on time, and troubleshoot day-of changes and scheduling conflicts with a calm, solutions-oriented approach, making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly. Build strong recruiting foundations This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. review_candidates.title: PMO Team Leader / Delivery Manager (H/F)
review_candidates.description: En quelques mots : Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Delivery Manager & PMO pour renforcer nos équipes Lyonnaise, sous la direction de Régis, Responsable d’Agence. Travailler chez MIGSO-PCUBED , c’est intégrer une communauté passionnée par le contrôle projet , engagée dans l’excellence opérationnelle, l’innovation et l’intelligence collective. Vous interviendrez à double titre : en tant que PMO opérationnel et Delivery Manager , sur des projets industriels complexes au sein de nos clients grands comptes. Votre mission : Project Control (Mission PMO) Vous accompagnez nos clients en intervenant de manière structurante sur les axes suivants : planification , gestion des coûts , analyse des risques & opportunités , reporting et aide à la décision . Vos responsabilités principales : Piloter la planification : construction, mise à jour, animation des plans projet (ressources, charges, jalons, interdépendances). Gérer les coûts projet : suivi budgétaire, analyse des écarts, reporting. Identifier et suivre les risques et opportunités , proposer des actions de mitigation ou de valorisation. Produire et structurer les reporting projets, en appui à la gouvernance. Mettre en œuvre des actions correctives en cas de dérive. Animer les routines projet internes et externes (comités de pilotage, points de suivi, etc.). Relation client & performance delivery (Mission Delivery Manager) : En tant que Delivery Manager, vous êtes garant(e) de la qualité des prestations réalisées et du bon déroulement des missions confiées, dans une logique de performance opérationnelle et de maîtrise du contrôle projet. Vous intervenez sur trois dimensions principales : Performance delivery : assurer l'exécution efficace des prestations sur l’ensemble de votre périmètre, avec un focus sur la rentabilité, la fiabilité des livrables et la maîtrise des engagements contractuels. Relation client : construire une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, en assurant un suivi rigoureux, en anticipant les évolutions de besoin, et en valorisant les expertises disponibles. Supervision opérationnelle : accompagner au quotidien les consultants dans leurs missions, garantir un alignement avec les attentes clients et mobiliser les expertises internes en cas de besoin. Vos responsabilités incluent : Suivi structuré des prestations (revues d’activité, reporting opérationnel, consolidation des indicateurs clés). Détection d’opportunités de développement, extension de périmètre, participation aux réponses à appels d’offres. Garantie d’un haut niveau de satisfaction client via la qualité des livrables, la tenue des engagements et la clarté des échanges. Contribution à la performance collective à travers les outils internes de contrôle projet (e-delivery, tableaux de bord, KPIs…). Management des équipes Vous encadrez votre équipe de consultants dans une dynamique de développement professionnel, d’excellence opérationnelle et d’appropriation des bonnes pratiques du contrôle projet. Votre rôle s’articule autour des axes suivants : Accompagnement individuel : cadrage des missions, présence terrain, feedbacks réguliers pour renforcer les compétences et l’autonomie des consultants. Animation collective : favoriser la cohésion d’équipe, encourager les partages d’expérience, créer des passerelles entre les projets, les managers et les fonctions support. Développement des talents : contribuer activement à l’intégration, la fidélisation et l’évolution des collaborateurs vers des missions à haute valeur ajoutée. Votre profil : Nous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) engagé(e), avec une forte appétence pour le terrain , une vision transverse et un leadership naturel . Formation Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou équivalent), spécialisation en gestion de projet, ingénierie ou management. Expérience 3 à 15 ans d’expérience (hors alternance) en Project Control / gestion de projets complexes , dans des environnements industriels ou grands programmes. Expérience confirmée en planification (planning, jalons, charges, dépendances). Expérience en management d’équipe opérationnelle ou transverse exigée. Compétences clés Management de projet et pilotage de la performance. Leadership, rigueur, adaptabilité et excellent relationnel. Maîtrise des outils opérationnels de pilotage projet (idéalement : MS Project, Planisware, Primavera, Power BI…). Très bonne capacité d’analyse, de structuration et de gestion des priorités. Langues : Français courant + Anglais courant (collaboration avec clients ou partenaires internationaux). Conditions du poste : Localisation : Lyon et ses environs Contrat : CDI – Statut cadre. Avantages : Participation à hauteur de 80€/mois à votre abonnement transport. Carte ticket restaurant (10€/jour). RTT et congés d’ancienneté. CSE actif : chèques cadeaux, culture, vacances… Parcours de carrière individualisé : mentoring, coaching, formations internes. Environnement bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement professionnel. Pour ce poste, la fourchette de rémunération annuelle brute est comprise entre 40 000 € et 60 000 €, selon le profil et l’expérience.

review_candidates.title: PM & functional analyst
review_candidates.description: Markas è un’azienda familiare con più di 13.000 collaboratori che da oltre 40 anni offre servizi di pulizia, ristorazione, facility e housekeeping, mettendo al centro persone, qualità e innovazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un/a PM & functional analyst da inserire all'interno del nostro IT & Innovation Department. La risorsa si occuperà di: assicurare la governance e l'organizzazione dei progetti IT, garantendo una visione d'insieme costante su obiettivi, tempi e risorse; condurre l’analisi dei requisiti e la progettazione funzionale, mappando i processi AS-IS e formalizzando i nuovi workflow TO-BE; scomporre i progetti in fasi operative, definendo milestone e deliverable critici e monitorando l'avanzamento; supervisionare le fasi di implementazione tecnica, agendo come facilitatore tra il team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder aziendali; coordinare l'esecuzione degli User Acceptance Test (UAT) da parte degli utenti, rilevando e notificando eventuali non conformità o scostamenti rispetto ai requisiti; gestire la comunicazione verso gli stakeholder e il project team, fornendo aggiornamenti puntuali e redigendo la documentazione tecnica e funzionale a supporto del progetto. Requisiti Chi stiamo cercando: diploma o laurea; comprovata esperienza nella gestione e nel coordinamento di progetti IT complessi, preferibilmente in ambiti legati alla Digital Transformation; padronanza delle metodologie di analisi funzionale e capacità di modellazione dei processi (BPMN o standard equivalenti); conoscenza delle metodologie di Project Management (Scrum/Kanban) e dei relativi strumenti di monitoraggio (Jira, Microsoft Project o simili); attitudine all'analisi e al consolidamento dei dati, con conoscenza avanzata di Excel; buona conoscenza della lingua inglese; orientamento al risultato, ottime capacità di pianificazione e attitudine al lavoro di squadra. Cosa offriamo: possibilità di crescita professionale; formazione continua; corsi di lingua inglese e tedesca; portale di convenzioni e scontistiche; palestra 24/7. Sede di lavoro: Bolzano Contratto: full-time, orario flessibile e smart working. Retribuzione annua lorda: 30.000-42.000 € Ti riconosci in questo profilo? Inviaci subito la tua candidatura! Ai sensi della Legge n° 903/77 l'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati di ambo i sessi.

review_candidates.title: Montessori Teacher
review_candidates.description: Company Description Bingo Tots Montessori is an early childhood learning center that follows Montessori principles to support holistic development in young children. The school provides a nurturing, child-centered environment where learners are encouraged to explore, discover, and grow at their own pace. Bingo Tots Montessori emphasizes independence, respect, and practical life skills through carefully prepared learning spaces and materials. The team is committed to partnering with families to create a safe, inclusive, and engaging educational experience. Located in Kitwe, the school aims to build strong foundations for lifelong learning. Role Description The Montessori Teacher will design and facilitate learning experiences that align with Montessori philosophy for early childhood learners. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing and organizing the classroom environment, presenting Montessori materials and lessons, observing learners to tailor activities to individual needs, and maintaining accurate records of learner progress. The role involves fostering independence, social-emotional development, and respect, as well as supporting routines such as circle time, outdoor play, and practical life activities. The teacher will communicate regularly with families about learner progress and participate in staff meetings, planning sessions, and school events. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Lusaka. Qualifications Strong classroom management and child supervision skills, with the ability to create a calm, organized, and engaging learning environment. Montessori diploma Experience in early childhood education, including planning age-appropriate lessons and activities that support cognitive, social, and emotional development. Knowledge of Montessori philosophy and methods, including the use of Montessori materials and observation-based teaching. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with learners, families, and colleagues in a supportive and respectful manner. Ability to maintain accurate learner records, monitor progress, and adjust teaching strategies based on individual needs. Commitment to inclusivity, learner safety, and adherence to school policies and child protection standards. Relevant teaching qualification or certification in early childhood education; Montessori training or certification is highly beneficial. Prior experience teaching in a Montessori or similar child-centered setting is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Junior Marketing Artist
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Small Giant Games is one of the top-performing mobile gaming companies in the world. We are proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We believe small, skilled, and independent teams can accomplish gigantic things. We know the best teams are created by hiring the best individuals and by trusting these individuals with ownership and responsibility for the work they do. Transparency, low hierarchy, and a good work-life balance are not just buzzwords for us but critical parts of our culture. We focus on the essentials while constantly looking to learn more and improve our products, our processes, and how we work together as a company. You will join the Creative team as a Junior Marketing Artist with a strong focus on AI, helping us produce creatives faster and contributing to the growth of Empires & Puzzles. Responsibilities Produce UA videos, playables and static ads, using AI tools as a core part of your daily work. Help build and improve AI workflows for the creative team, together with the senior artists. Look for new AI tools, workflows and solutions that can speed up our creative production, and share them with the team. Support the motion graphics and video artists with AI-generated assets, variations and quick iterations. Play Empires & Puzzles and other mobile games, and follow market and ad creative trends to bring fresh ideas into our creatives. Learn from performance data and team feedback to keep improving your creatives. Requirements Very AI-savvy, with hands-on experience in generative AI tools for image, video or animation. Working knowledge of Photoshop and After Effects. Quick learner who can pick up new tools fast and is curious about emerging tech. Passionate gamer who plays Empires & Puzzles (or is willing to dive in) and keeps up with other mobile games. Follows mobile gaming and ad creative trends closely, with a basic understanding of the market. Strong, confident communication, and an energetic, proactive attitude. Nice to have A portfolio showing AI-assisted creative work. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. Please contact us at accommodationRequest@zynga.com to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position. Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Zynga also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. review_candidates.title: Integration Specialist
review_candidates.description: Founded in Turin in 1968, Italdesign is a product and systems integrator that turns complex ideas into validated, market-ready physical products, with a single team taking responsibility for integrating hardware, software and validation, and delivering either complete programs or individual modules according to each Client's needs. Headquartered in Moncalieri, in the Turin area, Italy, Italdesign employs approximately 1,300 professionals across 10 sites in Italy, Germany, Spain, the United States and China. The company’s capabilities are organized around four integrated pillars: Digital Engineering & Validation, Physical Engineering, Manufacturing and Human-centered Design. Bringing together expertise in user research, design, architecture definition, engineering, E/E and software integration, prototyping, virtual and physical validation, homologation, production launch support, and pre-series and limited/ultra-limited series manufacturing, Italdesign supports product development through a single integrated organization. Automotive, bespoke and limited-series vehicles, mobility, aerospace, robotics, product and industrial design are the main sectors in which these capabilities are applied. Since September 2026, Italdesign has been a UST company. By combining its engineering capabilities with UST’s expertise in software, data and AI, Italdesign is expanding its ability to develop intelligent, connected products while remaining a multi-client partner and protecting the information and intellectual property of every program. In 2026 Italdesign obtained the Top Employers Certification for the eleventh year in a row. Posizione: Italdesign is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic person to join our Integration team. As an Integration specialist, you will be involved in different projects to integrate new/modified components or subsystem in existing platforms. You will implement the technical concepts required by standards and regulations according to the specific project constraints. You will evaluate performance and functional results to manage the final release of the integration process and remove defects affecting the related functional domain. You will be responsible for SW and HW configuration and ensure all systems work properly together and you will be part of an interdisciplinary, networked and Agile team. Together with Integration specialists and Integration step managers, you will be part of the development process for series and pre-series vehicles. Responsibilities Leading the design, development and integration of complex systems for Automotive, Aerospace and Robotics projects; System requirements and System test requirements creation and maintenance; Design and execution of Functional smoke tests on test benches both in simulation environment and with real ECU, as well as on complete vehicles; Interface with other Function Developers to define and manage function impacts on other domains; Issue tracking, defect analysis and driving corrective actions across the software development lifecycle; Manage impacts to New SW due to vehicle architecture changes: troubleshooting and DTCs analysis; Manage the production release process to finally deliver the component in series ensuring the product quality; Deep diagnosis on board for all system and ECUs; Responsible for SW and HW configuration installed in the vehicle. Requisiti: Key Requirements Minimum 5+ years of experience in automotive software integration and/or Electric and Electronic Architectures (Tier1/OEMs) Strong knowledge of the common Bus network technologies and protocols (e.g. CAN, FlexRay, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP etc.) Experience with CANOe, Canape tools Proven leadership and team coordination skills, with strong decision-making and complex problem-solving abilities à 4 Vincolante Experience on various engineering management systems (System42, Doors, Ti-Rex, KVS, Jira, Confluence, etc…); Experience in Network to identify/establish errors and first level analysis, as well as proper error address to component and function owners Preferential Requirements Knowledge of Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software System requirements and specifications; Prior experience in ECU's SW Validation or ECU series SW design/development; Experience with Version management tool; Experience with diagnosis tool and ISO 14229 (UDS protocol); Experience with SW update and troubleshooting; Experience with HW and SW product development and maintenance. Altre informazioni: Education: Master’s degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer or Automation Engineering or similar Language skills: Fluent knowledge of written and spoken English is mandatory. Knowledge of Italian and German would be appreciated Workplace: Moncalieri (TO) and availability to travel Compensation Package Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL) Italian National Metalworkers’ Collective Labour Agreement. Base Salary (RAL) The gross annual base salary offered for this position will be no less than € 36.000 Final Compensation The final compensation package will be determined based on the candidate’s professional experience, competencies and qualifications, and on the applicable role level, in line with the company’s internal compensation framework. The final salary may therefore be higher than the minimum amount stated above. Variable Compensation Eligible employees will participate in the company’s variable compensation programmes, subject to role eligibility and the applicable company policies in force at the time of employment. Details will be discussed during the recruitment process. Benefits In addition to base compensation, employees may have access to a range of benefits, depending on role, including: Continuous professional development (technical, soft skills and language training) Company canteen Health insurance Car leasing programme (if applicable) Smart working (if applicable) Flexible benefits programme Italdesign is committed to providing fair, transparent and gender-neutral compensation practices, in line with applicable legislation and the principles of equal pay for equal work. Italdesign is committed to create an inclusive, diverse and safe workplace, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer (L.903/77). We welcome applications from all candidates, regardless of the gender, ethnic, religion, sexual orientation, disability, parental status, or social origin.

Unsere Consultants, selbst erfahrene Informatiker und Ingenieure, beraten Sie in allen Karrierefragen und unterstützen Sie bei der Auswahl geeigneter Positionen.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur(e) Programmation Mission Expérimenté(e) - Spatial - Toulouse
review_candidates.description: Description De L'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Explorer, observer, sécuriser l’espace de demain. Avec 50 ans d’expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d’œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l’Europe. Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l’innovation de l’écosystème spatial. Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l’Espace. Portées par l’IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens. Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c’est façonner le futur de l’espace aux côtés d’experts passionnés. Description Du Poste Nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) expérimenté(e) dans le domaine de la programmation mission pour rejoindre notre Business Unit Espace au sein de la direction d’activité Mission Center . Notre entité est spécialisée dans les activités ingénierie, développement, validation et maintenance des Centres de Mission et de programmation satellite. Vos missions Vous venez renforcer notre équipe d’ingénieurs qui participent à des d’études et développement d’outils dans ce domaine. Dans ce cadre, vous devez : Réaliser le maquettage d’algorithmes de simulation /programmation mission Mettre en œuvre des moyens de simulation / programmation mission pour des études / analyses Concevoir, développer et gérer la maintenance des moyens de simulation mission Effectuer la validation fonctionnelle des moyens de simulation mission Gérer la responsabilité technique L'environnement technique Plateforme de développement Mécanique spatiale, dont le guidage en attitude Techniques spatiales : gestion bord, contrôle d’attitude et d’orbite, énergie, thermique, propulsion Méthodes pour le calcul d’un plan de programmation mission Techniques d’optimisation sous contraintes Techniques d’ordonnancement et de planification Qualifications De formation ingénieur(e) ou diplômé(e) d'un titre équivalent universitaire (Bac+5), vous avez une ou plusieurs expériences dans le domaine de la programmation mission (segment sol spatial) . La maîtrise du codage, du développement et de la validation notamment en Java, C++ et Python est indispensable à l'exercice de vos fonctions. Vous êtes autonome et rigoureux(se) , capable d'analyser et de comprendre des situations complexes avec aisance ? Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais , aussi bien à l’écrit qu’à l’oral ? Vous êtes doté(e) d’un très bon sens du relationnel et de solides compétences en communication ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons ! Informations supplémentaires Rejoignez une entreprise où l’humain, l’innovation et l’impact se rencontrent. Chez CS, nous offrons : Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante, portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l’autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien. Un parcours d’intégration complet pensé pour embarquer chaque talent dès le premier jour et une Academy pour développer vos compétences, enrichir votre expertise et construire les parcours professionnels qui vous ressemblent. Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3 000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain. …et bien d’autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant ! Notre singularité ? L’alliance unique entre expertise technologique, projets critiques et engagement humain. Entreprise innovante et responsable, nous construisons un environnement éthique, inclusif et tourné vers l’avenir. Ouverts à tous les talents, nous croyons que la diversité est une richesse. La suite des évènements Si votre profil correspond, vous serez invité à un entretien technique avec l’un de nos Responsables opérationnels, pour échanger sur vos compétences et votre vision du métier. Vous rencontrerez ensuite Elodie ou Laura pour un moment d’échange autour de votre parcours, vos aspirations et notre culture d’entreprise. Enfin, parce que nous valorisons la transparence et le respect, nous nous engageons à vous faire un retour personnalisé par téléphone, quelle que soit l’issue du processus. #CSGROUP #space #hiring #programmationmission Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils. https://www.soprasteria.fr/nous-connaitre/nos-engagements
